node.title: L1 fixed-support defect Johnson bound
node.statement: For one source chart and exact labelled petal support of size h, distinct exact saturated degree-d defect sets inside the (k-1)-point source core intersect in at most r_J=2d-h. Hence a negative-r_J cell is a singleton, while every cell with d^2>(k-1)r_J has size at most (k-1)(d-r_J)/(d^2-(k-1)r_J). All positive-denominator cells are polynomial per source chart at fixed petal polarity, with no field or syndrome factor. Thus a bounded-polarity counterfamily may be restricted to (k-1)(e-1)>=d^2; retaining the background gap g=ell-b further gives d^2<=(k-1)(d-g).
